notes: This is an ARM PC (e.g. Snapdragon). macOS for PCs only exists for x86-64 Intel/AMD processors; there is no way to run it here.
Windows is booted in Legacy BIOS/CSM mode. OpenCore requires UEFI. Switch the firmware to UEFI boot (convert Windows with MBR2GPT) and run HackWizard again. PCs without UEFI are not supported.

requires.gpu: Graphics: no GPU that macOS can drive was found. Laptops with Intel 11th-gen (Tiger Lake) or newer, or AMD Ryzen 6000-series or newer graphics have no macOS driver, and laptop graphics chips cannot be replaced, so macOS cannot run usefully on them. Desktops: install a supported AMD Radeon card (RX 460–590, Vega, RX 5500/5600/5700, RX 6600/6650/6800/6900) and run HackWizard again.

recommends.net-install: Network: no built-in Ethernet that macOS supports was found. The macOS installer downloads macOS from Apple and Wi-Fi does not work inside it. Use a USB-to-Ethernet adapter that macOS supports natively (for example ASIX AX88179 or Realtek RTL8153 based), or an iPhone's USB Personal Hotspot.

notes: Lilu + VirtualSMC, verbose install boot-args, SecureBootModel=Disabled and ScanPolicy=0 for the install (Dortania).
Battery via SMCBatteryManager (+ECEnabler for wide EC fields), backlight via SSDT-PNLF, fake EC + USB power via SSDT-EC-USBX.
Fake EC + USB power properties via SSDT-EC-USBX.
No hardware light sensor; a fake ALS0 keeps the brightness slider persistent.
PS/2 keyboard, trackpad and TrackPoint via VoodooPS2Controller (includes VoodooInput).
I2C-HID trackpad via VoodooI2C. Many trackpads work immediately; some need GPIO pinning (see VoodooI2C docs). A USB mouse is useful during install.
Trackpad interface not detected; the PS/2 driver is added for the keyboard. Keep a USB mouse handy.
Sleep is often broken on AMD laptops. If it misbehaves, disable sleep.
postInstall: If sleep fails: sudo pmset -a hibernatemode 0 && sudo pmset -a standby 0 && sudo pmset -a autopoweroff 0

notes: Many 10th-gen laptops only implement Windows 'Modern Standby' (S0ix), which macOS cannot use; sleep may not work.
This board declares CPUs as ACPI0007 devices (common on B550/A520). If the installer stalls early, these boards need SSDT-CPUR from Dortania's AMD guide (not generated automatically).
